title: Titan Pro 15K Grape Ice Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: Grape Ice layers dark, sweet Grape with a cool Menthol edge for a refreshing finish. The mesh-coil pod delivers clean flavour and discreet vapour, while the refill container maintains coil saturation for consistent performance. Built for the Titan Pro 15K device. Each Titan Pro 15K Prefilled Pod pack includes a 2ml pod and a 10ml refill container for the Titan Pro 15K device. The mesh coil ensures precise vapour output, while the refill system maintains coil saturation for steady performance. Check out our complete selection of Titan Pro 15k refill pods to find your next favourite flavour. How To Set Up Titan Pro 15K Pods Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod into the Titan Pro 15K device until it clicks. Step 2 Fit the 10ml refill container securely into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Replace both when empty. ✅ You're all set!
